channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trey Lyles | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trey Lyles from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trey Murphy on Jonas Valanciunas, Trey Lyles
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Trey Murphy on why he wasn’t fazed or concerned about a possible altercation breaking out between Jonas Valanciunas and Trey Lyles in Monday’s win:

“There wasn’t going to be anything happening. We all know who the big dog was in that fight.”

Trey Murphy on Jonas Valanciunas, Trey Lyles, Dec 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Michael Malone on Trey Lyles
item.description:
Michael Malone on why Trey Lyles did not play in Cleveland Saturday:

“When Jeff Green was ruled out, that was kind of Trey’s matchup. They played so much small ball. I just felt it was just not a great matchup for Trey for us. He will be back playing tomorrow night.”

Michael Malone on Trey Lyles, Mar 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Trey Lyles, Kenneth Faried
item.description:
#Nuggets coachMichael Malone on why Kenneth Faried is not currently part of the rotation:

“Our job is to win games, and we’re winning games right now... Why would I play him over Nikola (Jokic) or Trey Lyles with how well they’re playing right now?”

Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Trey Lyles, Kenneth Faried, Dec 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.
